title: Options traders price Nvidia's smallest post‑earnings swing in three years
title_zh: 期权交易员对英伟达的定价为三年来最小的财报后波动
summary: Traders in the equity options market are unusually subdued about how much Nvidia's quarterly results might move the stock, even as investors hope the chipmaker's ‌earnings report will shed light on the outlook for the artificial-intelligence trade.
summary_zh: 尽管投资者希望这家芯片制造商的盈利报告能够揭示人工智能行业的前景，但股票期权市场的交易员对于英伟达的季度业绩可能会对股价产生多大影响异常低迷。

title: Russia fines Google for distributing VPN services, TASS reports
title_zh: 塔斯社报道，俄罗斯因谷歌分发 VPN 服务而对谷歌处以罚款
summary: MOSCOW, Feb 25 () - A Russian ‌court has ‌fined Alphabet's Google ​over 22 million roubles ($288,000) for distributing VPN (virtual ‌private network) ⁠services on the Google ⁠Play app store, state ​news ​agency ​TASS reported ‌on Wednesday.
summary_zh: 莫斯科，2 月 25 日 - 据国家新闻机构 TASS 周三报道，俄罗斯一家法院因在 Google Play 应用商店分发 VPN（虚拟专用网络）服务而对 Alphabet 旗下的谷歌处以超过 2200 万卢布（288,000 美元）的罚款。

title: Anthropic Drops Hallmark Safety Pledge in Race With AI Peers
title_zh: Anthropic 在与人工智能同行的竞赛中放弃了标志性的安全承诺
summary: The company in 2023 said in its Responsible Scaling Policy that it would delay AI development that might be dangerous. In a Tuesday blog post, Anthropic said it was updating its rules to say it would no longer do so if it believes it lacks a significant lead over a competitor.
summary_zh: 该公司在 2023 年的《负责任的扩展政策》中表示，将推迟可能危险的人工智能开发。 Anthropic 在周二的一篇博客文章中表示，它正在更新其规则，如果它认为自己对竞争对手缺乏显着领先优势，它将不再这样做。

title: Trending tickers: Nvidia, AMD, HP, Diageo and Aston Martin
title_zh: 热门股票：Nvidia、AMD、HP、Diageo 和 Aston Martin
summary: The latest investor updates on stocks that are trending on Wednesday
summary_zh: 周三投资者对股票趋势的最新更新

title: Gold prices rise after Trump's State of the Union speech
title_zh: 特朗普发表国情咨文演讲后金价上涨
summary: Gold prices rose on Wednesday morning, as investors digested Donald Trump's comments in his State of the Union address.
summary_zh: 随着投资者消化唐纳德·特朗普在国情咨文中的言论，金价周三上午上涨。

title: FTSE 100 LIVE: Stocks rise as UK energy bills set to fall by £117 a year
title_zh: FTSE 100 LIVE：随着英国能源费用每年下降 117 英镑，股市上涨
summary: Ofgem announced a 7% reduction of the energy price cap for the period covering 1 April to 30 June.
summary_zh: Ofgem 宣布将 4 月 1 日至 6 月 30 日期间的能源价格上限降低 7%。

title: Microsoft Japan raided over suspected violation of anti-monopoly law, source says
title_zh: 消息人士称，微软日本公司因涉嫌违反反垄断法而遭到突击搜查
summary: Japan's Fair Trade Commission raided Microsoft Japan's offices on ‌Wednesday as part of an investigation ‌into whether it improperly restricted customers of its ​Azure platform from using rival cloud services, a source with direct knowledge of the matter told Reuters.
summary_zh: 一位直接了解此事的消息人士告诉路透社，日本公平贸易委员会周三突击搜查了微软日本办事处，作为调查的一部分，调查该公司是否不当限制其 Azure 平台的客户使用竞争对手的云服务。

title: HSBC annual profits fall but top estimates
title_zh: 汇丰银行年度利润下降但最高预期
summary: HSBC reported a decline in annual profits, in results released on Wednesday, but still beat expectations for the year.
summary_zh: 汇丰银行周三公布的业绩报告称，年度利润有所下降，但仍超出了今年的预期。

title: The world’s Billionaires' Rows
summary: When money’s no object, where do you live?
summary_zh: 当钱不再是问题时，你住在哪里？
